original_visible_content.stem:
Case A: An employee learns that a drug produced by the pharmacy is associated with an event satisfying the applicable Massachusetts SADE trigger. The MOR first reads the employee's message three days later.

Case B: The preparation is also suspected to be defective and to have caused the SADE, bringing the described immediate defective-preparation policy into the assessment.

Which conclusion correctly addresses Case A? Select ONE answer.

choices.text: The described state pathway requires reporting only to the pharmacy's purchasing wholesaler.
Every ordinary side effect of any commercial medicine meets this pharmacy-produced SADE trigger.
The general seven-business-day provision permits disregarding the applicable immediate defective-preparation policy.
The employee-awareness trigger is not postponed until the MOR opens the message.

explanation.core_reasoning: 해당 규정은 어떤 pharmacy employee든 알게 된 시점을 사용한다. 일반 보고기한과 더 빠른 specific policy trigger를 함께 확인한다. 해당 pharmacy-produced SADE 경로의 수신기관을 구분한다. 제품의 제조·조제 주체와 사건 정의·결과가 충족되는지 먼저 판단한다.

choice_analysis.A:
선택하지 않아야 하는 잘못된 설명. 해당 pharmacy-produced SADE 경로의 수신기관을 구분한다.
교정된 설명: The described state pathway connects reporting to the Board, FDA MedWatch, and the Betsy Lehman Center.
choice_analysis.B:
선택하지 않아야 하는 잘못된 설명. 제품의 제조·조제 주체와 사건 정의·결과가 충족되는지 먼저 판단한다.
교정된 설명: This specific trigger should not be copied to every ordinary adverse effect of every accurately dispensed commercial medicine.
choice_analysis.C:
선택하지 않아야 하는 잘못된 설명. 일반 보고기한과 더 빠른 specific policy trigger를 함께 확인한다.
교정된 설명: The immediate defective-preparation policy cannot be ignored merely because a general seven-business-day provision exists.
choice_analysis.D: 선택해야 하는 옳은 설명. 해당 규정은 어떤 pharmacy employee든 알게 된 시점을 사용한다.

explanation.learning_boundary: 같은 family의 네 문항은 같은 두 사례와 네 판단을 공유하는 연습 변형이다. 독립적인 네 임상 사례로 세지 않는다.

original_visible_content.stem:
Case A: A section 503B outsourcing facility receives initial information about a serious and unexpected adverse drug experience involving its compounded prescription drug.

Case B: Material follow-up information arrives later, but the facility plans to hold it until the next annual registration renewal.

Which conclusion correctly addresses Case A? Select ONE answer.

choices.text: Follow-up information is reported only during annual registration.
The described adverse-experience records have no retention requirement after report submission.
The described initial FDA report is due as soon as possible and no later than 15 calendar days after initial receipt.
The federal 15-day limit removes any applicable faster Massachusetts reporting duty.

explanation.core_reasoning: Federal 503B의 initial receipt와 15 calendar days를 annual registration와 분리한다. 추가 정보 수령 또는 FDA 요구에 따른 follow-up 의무를 별도로 수행한다. 연방 AE 기록 10년과 다른 약국 기록기간을 구분한다. 동시에 적용되는 주 immediate·7 business days 등을 연방 한도로 대체하지 않는다.

교정된 설명: Applicable follow-up reporting has its own 15-calendar-day framework rather than the annual-registration schedule.
choice_analysis.B:

교정된 설명: The described adverse-experience records have a ten-year federal retention requirement.
choice_analysis.C: 선택해야 하는 옳은 설명. Federal 503B의 initial receipt와 15 calendar days를 annual registration와 분리한다.

original_visible_content.stem:
Case A: A pharmacy has reason to believe a preparation it dispensed is defective. No patient injury has yet been reported.

Case B: The pharmacy treats the recall log and the separate report for a dispensed sterile or complex nonsterile defect as one document with an identical trigger date in every event.

Which conclusion correctly addresses Case A? Select ONE answer.

choices.text: The recall log and defect report necessarily have the same trigger date because both mention seven days.
The described defect obligation calls for immediate recall and quarantine without waiting for proven patient injury.
The defective-preparation log may be destroyed when the recalled stock is removed.
Only sterile or complex preparations can ever be subject to the described basic recall and log duties.

explanation.core_reasoning: 알거나 합리적으로 알 이유가 있는 결함과 harm의 확정을 구분한다. Recall 후 log 이용 가능과 defect identification 후 report의 시작점이 다를 수 있다. 회수 제품 처리완료와 장기 추적기록 보존은 다른 의무다. 특정 CSP·complex 보고 범위만 보고 noncomplex의 기본 recall·log를 제외하지 않는다.

교정된 설명: The recall-based log-availability clock and the defect-identification reporting clock must be tracked separately.
choice_analysis.B: 선택해야 하는 옳은 설명. 알거나 합리적으로 알 이유가 있는 결함과 harm의 확정을 구분한다.

choice_analysis.D:

After a vaccination, a Massachusetts patient submits a valid MIIS data-sharing objection form. The pharmacy has not yet sent the immunization record to the Department.

Which duties remain? Select ALL that apply.

choices.text: Report the immunization through the applicable MIIS reporting process.
Handle the objection form and sharing-status update within the applicable receipt-based deadline.
Delete the pharmacy's immunization record to implement the objection.
Delay Department reporting until the patient reverses the objection.
Treat the objection as a withdrawal of permission for the vaccination already administered.

explanation.core_reasoning: MIIS의 보고·기록·다른 site와의 공유는 별도 의무다. Objection 수령일과 administration date도 다른 시계다.

choice_analysis.A: 다른 sites와의 공유 반대가 Department 보고 자체를 면제하지 않는다.
choice_analysis.B: 양식 수령에 따른 24시간 경로와 접종 후 72시간 보고를 구별한다.
choice_analysis.C: 공유 제한은 pharmacy의 적법한 기록을 삭제하라는 의미가 아니다.
choice_analysis.D: 법정 reporting을 환자의 sharing 철회 때까지 유예할 수 없다.
choice_analysis.E: 접종 동의와 기록 sharing 상태는 서로 다른 결정이다.

Which date starts the applicable order-fulfillment period? Select ONE answer.

choices.text: October 20, the first shipment date.
October 1, the order date.

The date the purchaser requests the remaining quantity.

choice_analysis.D: 잔량 요청을 다시 했다는 사실로 원주문의 기한이 초기화되지 않는다.

Which handling approach is appropriate? Select ONE answer.

Remove usable tablets for the pharmacy's return-to-stock bin.
Sort the contents by patient before resealing the same liner.
Open the liner under a single technician's supervision.
